_comment: The installer's catalogue of EXTERNAL plugins (`install.sh --with <id>`). In-repo builtins are NOT listed here: ship.json (or an optional extension's own ship.json) + release.json decide those. An entry is installable only with listed:true; listed:false is a known id the installer refuses in words. `ref` is a commit sha, never a branch: what the installer checks out is exactly what was verified. Copilot is listed after its real check: release:check (tests, live probe, drift) on Copilot CLI 1.0.98, 2026-11-12. Re-run it in the plugin repo before moving `ref`.

plugins.name: GitHub Copilot CLI backend
plugins.description: GitHub Copilot CLI as a backend (measured on Copilot CLI 1.0.98). Experimental.
